info.title: NovelAI Primary API
info.description:
The Primary API describes actions that our Frontend makes against the NovelAI backend.

      In general, third-party NovelAI API users should not engage with the Primary API beyond the /ai/ routes.

      Third-party API users developing user-facing applications must ask for a user's Persistent API token to continue.
      For security reasons it is not recommended to hold a user's credentials in plaintext.

      IMPORTANT: Existing and new API users must read the upcoming generation-specific documentation:

      Image Generation documentation: https://image.novelai.net/docs/index.html
      Text Generation documentation: https://text.novelai.net/docs/index.html
